subject: info-dy
title: (R)INFO.DY.------TH.CONT.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-9 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two) accompanying Braxton's introduction of economics as the late-seventies organizing factor: 'creativity does not exist separate from actual life, and/or life and death decisions … the reality position of a given culture is directly related to its life support systems — whether that system is its creativity or economics.' (R)INFO-DY (the reality of information dynamics) is crossed with TH-CONT (thrust continuance): the question is what information-dynamics produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with thrust-continuance — the crossing operating at the economic-reality level where unemployment figures and policy decisions register as actual information rather than abstract data. POL-DY (political dynamics) branches from the main line and carries PART (participation) at the upper-left. TH-CONT sits at the upper-right. WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) anchors the right output. ALT-F (alternative functionalism) sits below the central axis, on a line from WO-EXP-PRI. TRNS anchors the lower-center. PART appears a second time on the lower-right margin, branching from the ALT-F line and carrying TRNS.
